Beginner Guide: How This Call Trade Works in Plain Dollars

Why LEAPS instead of a short-dated call: With 297 days until 2027-09-17 and 0.80 delta, this option behaves ~80% like owning 100 shares for a fraction of the cash, while losing only $3.99/day to time decay.

Worst-case wallet risk: You pay $36.50 x 100 shares x 1 = $3,650.00 upfront. Even if XLV crashed 50% overnight, you cannot lose more than $3,650.00.

Volatility check: Implied Volatility is 22.7% vs. 20-day actual stock volatility of 24.3% (IV FAIR), so you are not overpaying panic premiums.
